topic: initial_sidebar_state="expanded" opposite of this in streamlit
result:
In Streamlit, `initial_sidebar_state="expanded"` means the sidebar is open by default. 

The opposite is `initial_sidebar_state="collapsed"`, which means the sidebar is closed by default.

Example:
```python
st.sidebar.image("image.jpg", initial_sidebar_state="expanded")  # Open
st.sidebar.image("image.jpg", initial_sidebar_state="collapsed")  # Closed
```
